envelope.event: string, one of the names below
envelope.actor_hash: anonymous per-person hash, only used to enforce min_people; never shown
envelope.claim_id_hash: hashed claim id, null for non-claim events
envelope.props: object, per event below. Flags and IDs only, never free text or patient data

claim_submitted.prior_auth_number_filled: bool (the number itself is never sent)
claim_submitted.notes_patterns: array of detector tags found in the notes field, matched inside the app
